storyCards.headline: These Boots Are Made For Walkin': The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Nancy Sinatra's "These Boots Are Made For Walkin'" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

These Boots Are Made For Walkin' was released in 1966.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
